title: Emergency authority granted verbally then acted upon
operational_setting: During an emergency, an authorized official verbally grants temporary authority that is acted upon before a formal digital record exists.
trust_boundary: Operator exercises exceptional public authority based on another actor's grant.
initial_state: Operator lacks ordinary authority for the exceptional action.
intended_transition: Emergency action becomes temporarily authorized and executed.

attack.removed_or_replaced: Machine-readable delegation object at action time
attack.procedure: Test whether the system can remain accountable if delegation is initially off-system and only reconstructed after execution.

success_criteria_for_attack: If portable pre-action delegation provenance is unnecessary for safe/legitimate operation in emergency conditions, universality claims must narrow.

verdict.rationale: Tests delayed formalization and emergency exception cases.
